race.comment: WHATALEGACY (4) lightly raced gelding with an excellent win record. Resumed for his second prep with a slick all-the-way win over 1100m at Canterbury in fast time. Can handle the weight increase in this stronger race. Go close. STREET ARTIST (8) drawn out at all four starts this prep and finally comes up with the rails draw. Snagged back in a on pace contest when fourth over 1100m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Tempo suits and look for him pinching runs along the inside. MANUKAU (14) get back type who savaged the line in his two starts from awkward draws. Finds a nice race and expected to go close. BEAU BANDIT (11) well supported first up after showing good early speed to grip on and finish a narrow second over 1000m here. Underrated type who must be considered. The chances don't end there.
